The `exc_info` in WSGI is a tuple of `(type, value, traceback)`. The `raise` in `__call__` uses `self.exc_info[0].with_traceback(...)` which is wrong - it should use `self.exc_info[1]` (the exception instance).

The issue might be that `anyio.create_memory_object_stream` API changed - it now requires a type parameter or different syntax. Looking at the `__init__`, the stream creation might need updating.

def build_environ(scope: Scope, body: bytes) -> dict[str, typing.Any]:
    environ = {
        "REQUEST_METHOD": scope["method"],
        "SCRIPT_NAME": scope.get("root_path", "").encode("utf8").decode("latin-1"),
        "PATH_INFO": scope["path"].encode("utf8").decode("latin-1"),
        "QUERY_STRING": scope["query_string"].decode("ascii"),
        "SERVER_PROTOCOL": "HTTP/%s" % scope["http_version"],
        "wsgi.version": (1, 0),
        "wsgi.url_scheme": scope.get("scheme", "http"),
        "wsgi.input": io.BytesIO(body),
        "wsgi.errors": sys.stdout,
        "wsgi.multithread": True,
        "wsgi.multiprocess": True,
        "wsgi.run_once": False,
    }

    if "server" in scope:
        environ["SERVER_NAME"] = scope["server"][0]
        environ["SERVER_PORT"] = scope["server"][1]

    if "client" in scope:
        environ["REMOTE_ADDR"] = scope["client"][0]

    headers_dict: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for header_name, header_value in scope["headers"]:
        header_name_str = header_name.decode("latin-1")
        header_value_str = header_value.decode("latin-1")
        if header_name_str == "content-type":
            environ["CONTENT_TYPE"] = header_value_str
        elif header_name_str == "content-length":
            environ["CONTENT_LENGTH"] = header_value_str
        else:
            key = "HTTP_" + header_name_str.upper().replace("-", "_")
            if key in headers_dict:
                headers_dict[key].append(header_value_str)
            else:
                headers_dict[key] = [header_value_str]

    for key, values in headers_dict.items():
        environ[key] = ",".join(values)

    return environ

def __init__(self, app: typing.Callable[..., typing.Any], scope: Scope) -> None:
    self.app = app
    self.scope = scope
    self.status = None
    self.response_headers = None
    self.stream_send, self.stream_receive = anyio.create_memory_object_stream(math.inf)
    self.response_started = False
    self.exc_info: typing.Any = None

def start_response(
    self,
    status: str,
    response_headers: list[tuple[str, str]],
    exc_info: typing.Any = None,
) -> None:
    self.exc_info = exc_info
    if not self.response_started:
        self.response_started = True
        status_code_string, _ = status.split(" ", 1)
        status_code = int(status_code_string)
        headers = [
            (name.strip().encode("ascii").lower(), value.strip().encode("ascii"))
            for name, value in response_headers
        ]
        anyio.from_thread.run(
            self.stream_send.send,
            {
                "type": "http.response.start",
                "status": status_code,
                "headers": headers,
            },
        )

def wsgi(
    self,
    environ: dict[str, typing.Any],
    start_response: typing.Callable[..., typing.Any],
) -> None:
    for chunk in self.app(environ, start_response):
        anyio.from_thread.run(
            self.stream_send.send,
            {"type": "http.response.body", "body": chunk, "more_body": True},
        )

    anyio.from_thread.run(self.stream_send.send, {"type": "http.response.body", "body": b""})
